breakthrough: The per-trit 1.26x binary encoding tax becomes a per-minimal-packet tax on a 72-trit control transaction: a binary host moves 144 bits where the ternary information content is about 114.1 bits.
claim_boundary: This is a traffic model for the minimal control packet, not a measured joule-per-packet hardware benchmark.
The route model uses the worst-case diameter-2 Holonet path; adjacent nodes use one hop.
Payload data scales linearly on top of this control envelope.
